contents.text: {"reason": "The agent ran ShowCommit on HEAD and reported what the commit changed, drawing directly from the commit output: the commit ref, author, date, message, the 8 files changed with insertion and deletion counts, and per-file descriptions taken from the commit message and stat. It accurately summarizes the change from the commit itself and does not invent details. The agent openly notes it only read the stat summary, not the full diff, which is honest and doesn't undermine that it reported what the commit changed from the commit.", "met": true}
